decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system extends the firm's core coolant management business, is still on the website, and fits the demand for high-pressure cooling in metalworking.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's filtration and sustainability positioning, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard, high-volume product line close to the firm's established offer, so dropping one is very unlikely.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core part of the conveying portfolio and are still actively presented on the website.
